body:
Pass 23. Epic 7 files too hot to review; the p0 at measurement.R:494 is still unfixed.

Worked out the post-fix Epic 8 picture instead, as arithmetic from your shape rules. At 50k nodes under 4 GiB: frame signature payload drops 18.6 GiB -> 17.9 MB, and full geometry() materialization fits up to q ~ 103 conditions (q=60 is 1.36 GiB, q=100 is 3.76 GiB, q=200 is 14.98 GiB). Query-first output is 0.38 MB regardless of q.

So Epic 8 can state a scope rather than a pass/fail: geometry() materialization supported to about q=100 at 50k nodes, query-first beyond that.

This also corrects my original review - I said retaining geometry "is exactly what does not scale" and implied it broke early. The trial-level figure holds but the crossover is q~103, so ordinary condition-level work materializes fine. Your query-first default already covers the rest.

Wall time is the gate that still needs real measurement: ~p^1.8 on this path, ~19 min extrapolated at 50k with q=4 alone. Worth measuring properly once the memory blocker clears. Table is in the note on Epic 8.
